about_the_game:
Wuilsafe: Roots is an endless journey with various challenges along the way.

  What had to happen to humanity for something immaterial to be born in the material world, but alive and capable of influencing our world?

  Now this world is inhabited only by genetically recreated animals, terrible monsters generated by science, an infection that copies nature, and you are a creature that could not physically appear in the world.

  But you're here, and you have to deal with everything that's happened here.



Surf the oceans of a changed world

Where will you go: North, West, South or East?
Different biomes with different conditions, opponents and challenges.



Game Features

  • A reinterpreted but still familiar classic roguelike.

  • Explore mysterious stone forests, copper trains buried alive, altars of fanatics of natural elements and much more.

  • Evolve by creating new objects from matter and antimatter: from a stone sledgehammer to copper electro gloves.

  • Use the environment for your own purposes: the world is fully interactive, you can destroy and build, as well as use it all in battle.

  • Your opponents also keep up with you, have a well-developed AI, can change the mood during the battle, use the environment and much more.

  • Peaceful creatures can also become enemies (beware of Warot infection!).

  • In addition to combat, you can build a base on your personal island, which will help you buy useful items.

  • It is possible to play in small sessions.

  • Immerse yourself in the world of retro aesthetics and be nostalgic with us!



No soulless procedural generation

The game world is created taking into account a variety of internal parameters that know what you want to see. The game adjusts so that you don't get bored.


Wuilsafe: Roots is your unique chance to try out the very roguelike where:

  • The battlefield goes to the surface, although no one forbids you to dig into the depths of the caves.

  • There is no boring leveling, there is only you and the equipment you have chosen.

  • Your game is truly unique and unlike anything else.

* The game is ready, but we will continue to update it further so that you can find even more locations, challenges and equipment to your liking!
